player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Com Igar''') posted a [[Light]] [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]] list on DeckTech in June 2001.
description: The idea behind this Quiet Mining Colony deck is to draw your opponent into a battle for Cloude City they cannot win.
cards: posted: Keeping The Empire Out Forever
posted: Aim High (alternate start vs. Podracing, Scum, and TIEs)
posted: Sorry About the Messx2 (don't use combo because of the destiny)
notes: Posted 13 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting': Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation, HFTMF (Heading For The Medical Frigate), Keeping The Empire Out Forever, Squadron Assignments, Menace Fades ('typically'), Bespin and Cloud City: North Corridor; these count toward the 60. Three Effects start via HFTMF and none is singled out as the starting Effect, so starting.effect is left empty.
Posted 'SOS' dested Son Of Skywalker (the strategy says 'SOS deploys to CC and can get his Saber', and he would use 'the UR' Luke if he had it); 'Ladno with Gun' dested Lando With Blaster Pistol.

Posted 'CC ...' sites dested the Light Cloud City pages: North Corridor, Lower Corridor, Guest Quarters ('Gurest Quarters'), West Gallery; 'CC Docking Bay' dested the Light Cloud City: Platform 327 (Docking Bay). 'Obi-Wan Kenobi' is the Premiere Obi-Wan, as the strategy says.

Posted 'Sorry About the Messx2 (don't use combo because of the destiny)' dested 2x Sorry About The Mess (the plain interrupt, not the combo); 'Weapon Levitation' dested the Light Jabba's Palace interrupt; 'Aim High (alternate start vs. Podracing, Scum, and TIEs)' dested the Aim High Effect; 'Proton Torpedos' dested Proton Torpedoes; 'Bespin Z-95 Defense Fighter' dested Z-95 Bespin Defense Fighter; 'Dash Renader' dested Dash Rendar.
Anakin's Podracer is posted under its own heading 'Effect Wannabee (1)'.

Total is 59 as published: 'Ships (6)' lists only five (3x Z-95, Blue Squadron 5, Blue Squadron B-wing). The strategy mentions the Outrider ('Dash and Outrider help me'), which is not in the list and is not added.
